script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let ability be a smart-weighted move of executer.
If ability is the id of the move labelled "jump" on executer, then executer uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}, {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: {shouldDeformAllNodes: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}].
Otherwise, executer uses ability.
